Game Overview

In Alex Meets Ally Autumn, the core idea is straightforward: unite Alex and Ally by skillfully hooking Alex to various objects. Engage in a challenging puzzle adventure where collecting stars unlocks new possibilities, and time is of the essence. The quicker your reunion, the higher your score. Can you master the mechanics and bring them together?
